# Performance tests 

# 1. Fluad, Vaccine

## Regression model
### Compute overall metrics for all genes
```{r}
#Import
pairwise_human_fit_test = readRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "pairwise_human_fit_measures.rds"))
pairwise_human_fit_measures = pairwise_human_fit_test
pairwise_human_fit_test$symbol %>% unique() %>% length() #6373

# Calculate metrics --------
#FIT------
#Define ranges of values for combinatorial analysis
filter_conditions_fit <- expand_grid(
  padj_fit = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.3, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

#Run analysis
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs <- filter_conditions_fit %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filter timepoint
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calculate the cutoff for each percentile
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_fit, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Apply cutoffs
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_adj_fit < fc$padj_fit,
        abs(mean_fit) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_fit <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          MAE = mae_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          R2 = rsq_vec(mean_human, mean_fit),
          Spearman = cor(mean_human, mean_fit, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(mean_human, mean_fit, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "FIT") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_fit) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))
#Print
filter_conditions_results_fit_degs

#Mouse --------
filter_conditions_mouse <- expand_grid(
  padj_mouse = c(0.01, 0.05, seq(0.1, 1, by = 0.1)),
  expr_cutoff = c(0.01, seq(0.05, 0.5, by = 0.05), 0.75, 1),
  ci_percentile = c(0.3, 1.0),
  timepoint = c(1, 3, 7)
)

filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs <- filter_conditions_mouse %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do({
    fc <- .
    
    # Filtrar apenas dados do timepoint atual
    data_timepoint <- pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
      filter(timepoint == fc$timepoint)

    # Calcular o cutoff do percentil escolhido
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(data_timepoint$ci_width_mouse, probs = fc$ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Aplicar filtros
    filtered_data <- data_timepoint %>%
      filter(
        pval_adj_mouse < fc$padj_mouse,
        abs(mean_mouse) > fc$expr_cutoff,
        ci_width_mouse <= ci_cutoff
      )

    if (nrow(filtered_data) >= 2) {
      metrics <- filtered_data %>%
        summarise(
          n_genes = n(),
          RMSE = rmse_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          MAE = mae_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          R2 = rsq_vec(mean_human, mean_mouse),
          Spearman = cor(mean_human, mean_mouse, method = "spearman"),
          Pearson = cor(mean_human, mean_mouse, method = "pearson")
        )
    } else {
      metrics <- tibble(
        n_genes = 0,
        RMSE = NA, MAE = NA, R2 = NA,
        Spearman = NA, Pearson = NA
      )
    }

    bind_cols(fc, tibble(ci_width_cutoff = ci_cutoff), metrics)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organism = "Mouse") %>%
  rename(padj_cutoff = padj_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(ci_percentile = paste0(ci_percentile * 100, "%"))
#Print
filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs  

#Merge
metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs = filter_conditions_results_mouse_degs %>% 
  bind_rows(filter_conditions_results_fit_degs) %>% 
  mutate(filter = if_else(organism == "FIT", paste0("FIT CI ", ci_percentile), NA),
         filter = if_else(organism == "Mouse", paste0("Mouse CI ", ci_percentile), filter)) %>% 
  select(organism,filter, everything()) %>% 
  filter(expr_cutoff <= 0.5)

#Save
metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs.rds"))

#Print
metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs
```

#### Plot regression metrics


#### RMSE
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_RMSE_plot = metrics_FIT_M_vs_FIT_filtered_DEGs %>%
  mutate(across(ci_width_cutoff:timepoint, as.character)) %>%
  mutate(filter = fct_relevel(filter, 
                              "Mouse CI 10%", 
                              "Mouse CI 30%", 
                              "Mouse CI 50%",
                              "Mouse CI 100%",
                              "FIT CI 10%",
                              "FIT CI 30%", 
                              "FIT CI 50%", 
                              "FIT CI 100%")) %>% 
  filter(filter %in% c("Mouse CI 30%",
                        "Mouse CI 100%",
                        "FIT CI 30%",
                        "FIT CI 100%")) %>% 
  filter(padj_cutoff <= 0.25) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = expr_cutoff, y = RMSE)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = filter,
                color = filter)) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = filter,
                 # size = n_genes
                 ),
             alpha = 0.8,
             pch = 21,
             # fill = NA,
             width = 0.1,
             # size = 0.5
             ) +
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(timepoint),
    cols = vars(padj_cutoff),
    switch = "both",
    labeller = labeller(
      timepoint = as_labeller(c("1" = "Day 1", 
                                "3" = "Day 3", 
                                "7" = "Day 7")),
      padj_cutoff = function(x) paste("padj:", x)  
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
  scale_size(range = c(0.1, 3), breaks = c(10, 100, 500, 1000)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(1, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "RMSE",
    x = "L2FC Cutoff",
    y = "RMSE",
    color = "",
    size = "Number of genes"
  ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse CI 30%" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse CI 100%" = "#80a1d4",
    "FIT CI 30%"   = "#4361ee",
    "FIT CI 100%"   = "#dec0f1"
  )) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse CI 30%" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Mouse CI 100%" = "#80a1d4",
    "FIT CI 30%"   = "#4361ee",
    "FIT CI 100%"   = "#dec0f1"
  ))
```

#### Plot correlation

Mouse vs Human (cutoffs for mouse)

```{r}
corr_plots_data = pairwise_human_fit_test %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, mean_mouse, mean_human, mean_fit,
         pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit),
               names_to = "measure",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    pval_cuts = case_when(
      value <= 0.01 ~ "0.01",
      value <= 0.05 ~ "0.05",
      TRUE ~ "1"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = measure,
    values_from = pval_cuts,
    values_fn = list
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(pval_adj_human, pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit)) %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_human, .direction = "down") %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_mouse, .direction = "up") %>% 
  fill(pval_adj_fit, .direction = "up") %>% 
  mutate(pval_cuts_mouse_human = if_else(pval_adj_human == pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_human, "Not equal"),
         pval_cuts_fit_human = if_else(pval_adj_human == pval_adj_fit, pval_adj_fit, "Not equal"),
         pval_cuts_mouse_fit = if_else(pval_adj_fit == pval_adj_mouse, pval_adj_fit, "Not equal")) 

corr_plots_data
```

## Classification model


### Classify by grid of cutoffs
```{r}
# Define cutoffs
padj_cutoffs <- c(0.05)
l2fc_cutoffs <- c(0, 0.5)
ci_percentiles <- c(0.3, 1.0)

# Expand grid
cutoff_grid <- expand_grid(
  padj_cutoff = padj_cutoffs,
  l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoffs,
  ci_percentile = ci_percentiles
)

# Classify by every combination
base_df <- pairwise_human_fit_genes_wide

classified_df <- pmap_dfr(
  cutoff_grid,
  function(padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, ci_percentile) {
    
    ci_cutoff <- quantile(base_df$ci_width, probs = ci_percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    base_df %>%
      filter(ci_width <= ci_cutoff) %>%
      mutate(
        padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff,
        l2fc_cutoff = l2fc_cutoff,
        ci_percentile = ci_percentile,
        classification = case_when(
          pval_adj < padj_cutoff & l2fc >= l2fc_cutoff  ~ "up",
          pval_adj < padj_cutoff & l2fc < -l2fc_cutoff ~ "down",
          TRUE                                          ~ "neutral"
    ))})

#Save
classified_df %>% 
  saveRDS(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "genes_l2fc_fit_mouse_human_classified_cutoffs.rds"))
```

###Import

```{r}
#Import
classified_df = read_rds(here("FIT_Mouse2man", "genes_l2fc_fit_mouse_human_classified_cutoffs.rds")) %>% 
  rename(padj_deg = pval_adj)

#Get only DEGs in humans
degs_human = classified_df %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human",
         padj_deg < 0.05) %>% 
  pull(symbol) %>% 
  unique()

length(degs_human)

#Summarize genes
classified_df_countgenes_degs_direction = classified_df %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(degs_human)) %>% 
  group_by(organism, timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, ci_percentile, classification) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()  %>% 
  mutate(across(c(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff), as.character))

#Print
classified_df_countgenes_degs_direction
```

```{r}
#Pivot wider
classified_wide <- classified_df %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, organism, classification) %>%
  filter(l2fc_cutoff == 0) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "organism", values_from = "classification") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Human) & !is.na(FIT) & !is.na(Mouse)) %>% 
  mutate(
    fit_correct = FIT == Human,
    mouse_correct = Mouse == Human
  )

classified_wide %>% glimpse()

classified_eval = classified_wide

my_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, precision, recall, f_meas, spec, sens)

### FIT
# "up" vs all
acc_up_vs_all_fit <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "up", "up", "not_up"), levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "up")

  mutate(
    truth = factor(ifelse(Human == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down")),
    estimate = factor(ifelse(FIT == "down", "down", "not_down"), levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff) %>%
  my_metrics(truth = truth, estimate = estimate) %>%
  mutate(model = "FIT", target = "down")

acc_fit_results <- bind_rows(acc_up_vs_all_fit, acc_down_vs_all_fit)

fit_classification_degs_ngenes <- classified_eval %>%
  mutate(
    truth = factor(Human, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    estimate = factor(FIT, levels = c("up", "down", "neutral")),
    correct = truth == estimate,
    incorrect = truth != estimate
  ) %>% 
  group_by(timepoint, padj_cutoff, l2fc_cutoff, truth) %>%
  summarise(
    num_correct_tp = sum(correct, na.rm = T),
    num_incorrect_fp = sum(incorrect, na.rm = T),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(model = "FIT")


fit_classification_degs_ngenes = bind_rows(fit_classification_degs_ngenes)

fit_classification_degs = acc_fit_results %>% 
  rename(truth = target) %>% 
  inner_join(fit_classification_degs_ngenes,
             by = join_by("model", "timepoint", "padj_cutoff", "l2fc_cutoff", "truth"))

fit_classification_degs %>% 
  arrange(-.estimate) %>% 
  filter(num_correct_tp > 0)
```

```{r}
#Manual example
dge_long_genes_up_example = dge_long_genes_down%>%

# Parameters

# log2fc <- -0.15

ci_high <- dge_long_genes_up_example$ci_high
z = dge_long_genes_up_example$z
pval_one_sided = pnorm(z, lower.tail = T) #one sided, higher
se <- dge_long_genes_up_example$se
direction = dge_long_genes_up_example$direction
df <- 120  #samples

# Null parameters
se_null <- se # Same SE
ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null

# x values (scaled for t-distribution)
x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = 500)
x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se, 4*se, length.out = 500)

# t-distribution densities
y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc)/se, df = df) / se
y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null

# Data frames
df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)

# Plot

# Destaque da cauda inferior da distribuição nula
shade_df_superior <- df_curve_null %>%
  filter(x >= log2fc) 

shade_df_inferior <- df_curve_gene %>%
  filter(x <= log2fc) 

ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda superior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_superior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "black", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Área sombreada da cauda inferior
  geom_area(data = shade_df_inferior, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  
  # Linhas de referência
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", as.character(pval_one_sided), ", ", direction),
       subtitle = condition,
       x = "log2 Fold Change",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))

```


Automated
Generate distributions for multiple genes
```{r}

#Plot T distributions
plot_t_distribution <- function(df, df_samples = 10, n_points = 500) {
  # df: data frame containing condition, log2fc, ci_low, ci_high, se columns
  # df_samples: degrees of freedom for t-distribution (default 120)
  # n_points: number of points for the curves
  
  # Function to create a plot for one row (one condition)
  create_plot <- function(row) {
    condition <- row$condition
    log2fc <- row$log2fc
    ci_low <- row$ci_low
    ci_high <- row$ci_high
    se <- row$se
    adj_p_val = row$adj_p_val
    direction = row$direction
    df <- df_samples
    
    
    # Null parameters (mean=0, same SE)
    se_null <- se
    ci_low_null <- 0 - qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    ci_high_null <- 0 + qt(0.975, df) * se_null
    
    # x ranges for observed and null
    x_vals <- seq(log2fc - 4*se, log2fc + 4*se, length.out = n_points)
    x_vals_null <- seq(-4*se_null, 4*se_null, length.out = n_points)
    
    # t-distribution densities
    y_vals <- dt((x_vals - log2fc) / se, df = df) / se
    y_vals_null <- dt(x_vals_null / se_null, df = df) / se_null
    
    # Data frames for plotting
    df_curve_gene <- data.frame(x = x_vals, y = y_vals, distribution = "Observed")
    df_curve_null <- data.frame(x = x_vals_null, y = y_vals_null, distribution = "Null")
    actual_null_dist <- bind_rows(df_curve_gene, df_curve_null)
    
    # Plot
    p <- ggplot(actual_null_dist, aes(x = x, y = y, color = distribution)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_high_null), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_low), linetype = "dashed", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = log2fc, linetype = "solid", color = "lightblue") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
      theme_vaxgo() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
            legend.position = "top") +
      labs(title = paste0(condition, ", ", "adj_pval = ", round(adj_p_val, 4), ", ", direction),
           x = "log2 Fold Change",
           y = "Density") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Observed" = "lightblue", "Null" = "black"))
    
    return(p)
  }
  
  # Apply the plotting function to each row
  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) create_plot(df[i, ]))
  
  # Optionally, name the list by conditions
  names(plots) <- df$condition
  
  return(plots)
}
```

Run

#### Confusion matrix
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(purrr) # Make sure this line is run before using reduce

##### Function
#Get summaries
get_confmat_summary <- function(data, model_selected, timepoint_selected) {
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>% # Assumes 'truth' and 'predicted' columns exist
    summary() %>% 
    mutate(model = model_selected,
           timepoint = timepoint_selected)
}


# Plot heatmap for every combination
plot_xconfmat_heatmap <- function(data, 
                                 model_selected, 
                                 timepoint_selected) {
  
  data %>%
    filter(model == model_selected, timepoint == timepoint_selected) %>%
    conf_mat(truth, predicted) %>%
    autoplot(type = "heatmap") +
    aes(
      fill = Freq,
      x = fct_rev(str_to_upper(Prediction)),
      y = str_to_upper(Truth),
      label = Freq
    ) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text() +
    scale_x_discrete(position = "top", expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      x = "Predicted",
      y = "Truth",
      title = paste(model_selected, "Day", timepoint_selected)
    ) +
    theme_vaxgo() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.line.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "white",
      high = "#80a1d4",
      n.breaks = 3
    )
}
```

## ROC Curve: Genes

Import data

```{r}
#Import DEGs table
dge_long_genes = read_rds(file= here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_fit_dge_degs_long.rds")) 
#Import metadata
human_mouse_fluad_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "influenza_fluad_human_mouse_metadata.rds.png"))
#ImmuneGO ontologies
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))


dge_long_genes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(organism != "FIT") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_fluad_metadata %>%
               group_by(organism, timepoint) %>%
               summarise(n = n()) %>% 
               mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint)),
               by = join_by("organism", "timepoint"))
#All genes
genes_roc_allgenes = dge_long_genes
#Filter immune genes
genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))

#Only DEGs
degs_genes_human = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint)

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_all = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint"))

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_immune = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Filter immune genes only
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))
```

Calculate ROC curve

Inputs
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
set.seed(123)
######### Input -----

#All genes

# filename = "influenza_fluad"
# gene_set_filename = "All_OnlyImmune"
# genes_df_input = bind_rows(
#   genes_roc_allgenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
#   genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
# )

#Human DEGs

filename = "influenza_fluad"
gene_set_filename = "HumanDEGs_OnlyImmune"
genes_df_input = bind_rows(
  genes_roc_DEGs_all %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
  genes_roc_DEGs_immune %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
)

```


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}

#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = sample(prob), 
         organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = sample(prob), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~paste("Day", timepoint)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)


# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, y = factor(timepoint) %>% fct_rev(), fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8,
           position = position_dodge()) +
  
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = round(auc, 2)),
            position = position_dodge2(0.9),
            hjust = 1.2, size = 2) +
  
  facet_grid(comparison ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    x = "AUC",
    y = "Day",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  auc_plot) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 0.4))+
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)),
                  title = filename)

roc_auc_curve_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_roc_curve_plot", gene_set_filename, ".png")),
         width = 8,
         height = 5)

roc_auc_curve_plot
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot


# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth

  mutate(organism = "Human")
```

# 2. Engerix B, Vaccine

## ROC Curve: Genes
Do for one direction (up and then down)
Do one sided t test for mouse, fit, and human
Positive control: Human
Neg control: Random permutation


Import data
```{r}
#Import =============
#Import ImmuneGO ontologies
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))
#Import metadata
human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Import DEGs table
all_degs_human = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(comparison_a, "Time"))
all_degs_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_mouse_degs_mouse.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Engerix_") %>% str_remove("_PBMC") %>% as.numeric(),
         timepoint = timepoint /24,
         timepoint = timepoint %>% as.character())


#Pre-process data
dge_long_genes_matched = all_degs_human  %>% 
  bind_rows(all_degs_mouse) %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol, log2fc = mean_l2fc, adj_p_val = adj_p_val)  %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata %>%
               group_by(organism, timepoint) %>%
               summarise(n = n()) %>% 
               mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
               by = join_by("organism", "timepoint")) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 7)




#Input ======================
dge_long_genes = dge_long_genes_matched

#All genes
genes_roc_allgenes = dge_long_genes
#Filter immune genes
genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))

#Only DEGs
degs_genes_human = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint)

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_all = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint"))

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_immune = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Filter immune genes only
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "up")) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup()


roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "down")) %>%    
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup()

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "up")) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  filter(any(truth == "down")) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0("Day" ,timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot

# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, 
             y = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% fct_rev(), 
             fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
           position = position_dodge(1)) +
  
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)

    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  (auc_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"))) +

                  title = paste(filename, gene_set_filename))
```

## ROC Curve: BTMs

```{r}
#Import ============
#Import DEGs table
dge_btm_mean_process = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_dge_btm_mean_process.rds"))

#Import metadata
human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "hepatitisb_engerixb_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))

#Pre-process data =============
all_btms_human_mouse = dge_btm_mean_process %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = as.numeric(timepoint))

all_btms_human_mouse_matched = all_btms_human_mouse

#Input ======================
set.seed(123)
filename = "hepatitisb_engerixb"
gene_set_filename = "BTMs"

btms_df_input = all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  rename(symbol = process)

```

Calculate ROC curve


```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

# roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
#   filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
#   group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
#   roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
#   mutate(comparison = "Down")

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve

  # bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = timepoint,
    timepoint = paste0("Day ", timepoint),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot


# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      # auc_results_down
                      ) %>%
```

# 3. S. aureus, Infection
## ROC Curve: Genes
Comparison must be done between human at day 1 and multiple mice timepoints 
```{r}
#Import
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_mouse_metadata.rds"))
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))


#Prepare
all_degs_human_mouse = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata %>%
               group_by(organism, timepoint) %>%
               summarise(n = n()) %>% 
               mutate(timepoint = as.character(timepoint)),
               by = join_by("organism", "timepoint")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(organism == "Human", "24", timepoint))


timepoint_reference = "24"
human_data_reference <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% filter(organism == "Human")
new_timepoints <- c(all_degs_human_mouse %>% filter(organism != "Human") %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character())
duplicated_human_data <- map_dfr(new_timepoints, ~ {
  df_copy <- human_data_reference
  df_copy <- df_copy %>%
    mutate(timepoint = .x)

  return(df_copy)
})

dge_long_genes_matched = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  bind_rows(duplicated_human_data) 

#Input
dge_long_genes = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol)

#All genes
genes_roc_allgenes = dge_long_genes 
#Filter immune genes
genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))

#Only DEGs
degs_genes_human = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint)

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_all = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint"))

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_immune = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Filter immune genes only
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))
```



Inputs
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
set.seed(123)
######### Input -----
# filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"
# gene_set_filename = "All_OnlyImmune"
# genes_df_input = bind_rows(
#   genes_roc_allgenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
#   genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
# )


filename = "saureus_infection_human_mouse"
gene_set_filename = "HumanDEGs_OnlyImmune"
genes_df_input = bind_rows(
  genes_roc_DEGs_all %>% mutate(model_type = "Mouse"),
  genes_roc_DEGs_immune %>% mutate(model_type = "Immune")
)

```




Calculate ROC curve
```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = genes_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n - 1,
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  select(-adj_p_val) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = if_else(model_type == "Immune", "Immune", organism)) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup()


roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup()

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot

# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, 
             y = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% fct_rev(), 
             fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
           position = position_dodge(1)) +
  
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = round(auc, 2)),
            position = position_dodge2(1),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 2, vjust = 0.5) +
  
  facet_grid(comparison ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    x = "AUC",
    y = "Day",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  (auc_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 0.4))+
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)),
                  title = paste(filename, gene_set_filename))

roc_auc_curve_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_performance_roc_", gene_set_filename, ".png")),
         width = 10,
         height = 5)

roc_auc_curve_plot
```

```{r}
all_btms_human_mouse %>% select(timepoint, organism) %>% distinct()

#Timpoints differ from human and model
human_data_reference <- all_btms_human_mouse %>% filter(organism == "Human")
new_timepoints <- c(all_btms_human_mouse %>% filter(organism != "Human") %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character())
duplicated_human_data <- map_dfr(new_timepoints, ~ {
  df_copy <- human_data_reference
  df_copy <- df_copy %>%
    mutate(timepoint = .x)

  return(df_copy)
})

all_btms_human_mouse_matched = all_btms_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  bind_rows(duplicated_human_data) 
#Check
all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% select(timepoint, organism) %>% distinct()

#Input ======================
set.seed(123)
filename = "saureus_infection"
gene_set_filename = "BTMs_NES"

btms_df_input = all_btms_human_mouse_matched %>% 
  rename(symbol = process)

```

Calculate ROC curve


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = set_size - 1,
    t = nes/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(set_size)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = btms_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = set_size - 1,
    t = nes/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(set_size)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot


# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_num = as.numeric(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)])) %>% fct_rev()) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, 
             y = timepoint,
             fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
           position = position_dodge(1)) +
  
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = round(auc, 2)),
            position = position_dodge2(1),
            color = "black", 
            hjust = 1.2, size = 3, vjust = 0.5) +
  
  facet_grid(comparison ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    x = "AUC",
    y = "Day",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  (auc_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 0.3))+
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)),
                  title = paste(filename, gene_set_filename))

roc_auc_curve_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_performance_roc_", gene_set_filename, ".png")),
         width = 10,
         height = 5)

roc_auc_curve_plot

```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%

  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot


# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, 
             y = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% fct_rev(), 
             fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
           position = position_dodge(1)) +

  ) +

    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  (auc_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"))) +
```

```{r}
#Import ============
#Import DEGs table
all_degs_mouse_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
all_degs_human_ecoli = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

#ImmuneGO ontologies
ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes = read_csv(file = here("VaxGO", "ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes.csv"))

#Import metadata
human_mouse_metadata = readRDS(file = here("tables", "ecoli_infection_human_mouse_metadata.rds")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = if_else(organism == "Human" & pathogen == "Escherichia coli", "24", timepoint),
         organism = if_else(organism == "Mus musculus", "Mouse", organism))



#Pre-process data =============
all_degs_human_mouse = all_degs_mouse_ecoli %>% 
  bind_rows(all_degs_human_ecoli) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint = str_remove(condition, "Ecoli_") %>% str_remove("h")) %>% 
  arrange(human_symbol) %>% 
  filter(organism != "FIT") %>% 
  inner_join(human_mouse_metadata %>%
               group_by(organism, timepoint) %>%
               summarise(n = n()),
               by = join_by("organism", "timepoint"))

human_mouse_metadata %>% select(timepoint, organism) %>% distinct()
all_degs_human_mouse %>% select(timepoint, organism) %>% distinct()

#Timpoints differ from human and model
timepoint_reference = "24"
human_data_reference <- all_degs_human_mouse %>% filter(organism == "Human")
new_timepoints <- c(all_degs_human_mouse %>% filter(organism != "Human") %>% pull(timepoint) %>% unique() %>% as.character())
duplicated_human_data <- map_dfr(new_timepoints, ~ {
  df_copy <- human_data_reference
  df_copy <- df_copy %>%
    mutate(timepoint = .x)

  return(df_copy)
})

dge_long_genes_matched = all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  bind_rows(duplicated_human_data) 
#Check
dge_long_genes_matched %>% select(timepoint, organism) %>% distinct()

#Input ======================
dge_long_genes = dge_long_genes_matched %>% 
  rename(symbol = human_symbol)

#All genes
genes_roc_allgenes = dge_long_genes
#Filter immune genes
genes_roc_allgenes_immunegenes = dge_long_genes %>% 
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))

#Only DEGs
degs_genes_human = dge_long_genes %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05,
         organism == "Human") %>%
  select(symbol, timepoint)

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_all = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint"))

#Only immune DEGs
genes_roc_DEGs_immune = dge_long_genes %>%
  inner_join(degs_genes_human,
             by = join_by("symbol", "timepoint")) %>%
  #Filter immune genes only
  filter(symbol %in% c(ImmuneGO_BTM_grouped_genes$genes %>% unique()))
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),

  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>%
```
