```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions
#=====================================================
perfect_prediction_up = truth_human_up %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "up", 1, 0),
         model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_up = perfect_prediction_up %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%
  mutate(prob = if_else(truth == "down", 1, 0),
          model = "Human") %>%
  rename(pred = truth)

permutation_prediction_down = perfect_prediction_down %>%
  group_by(timepoint) %>% 
  mutate(prob = runif(n()), organism = "Permutation",
         model = "Permutation")

#=====================================================
# Combine models (Mouse + Immune + Uniform + Perfect)
#=====================================================
models_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_up, permutation_prediction_up)

models_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  filter(organism != "Human") %>% 
  mutate(pred = direction,
         model = organism) %>%
  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)

#=====================================================
# Classify probabilities 
#=====================================================
classified_df_probs_up = truth_human_up %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_up %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("up", "not_up"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()

classified_df_probs_down = truth_human_down %>% 
  select(symbol, timepoint, truth) %>%
  inner_join(models_down %>% 
               select(symbol, timepoint, pred, prob, model),
             by = join_by(symbol, timepoint)) %>% 
  mutate(
    truth = factor(truth, levels = c("down", "not_down"))
  ) %>% 
  distinct()


#=====================================================
#Compute ROC 
#=====================================================

roc_curve_up_notup = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up")

roc_curve_down_notdown = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_curve(truth, prob) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down")

#=====================================================
#Compute AUC 
#=====================================================
auc_results_up = classified_df_probs_up %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "up", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Up") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

auc_results_down = classified_df_probs_down %>% 
  mutate(truth = fct_relevel(truth, "down", after = 0)) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation", "Human", "FIT")) %>%
  group_by(model, timepoint) %>%
  roc_auc(truth, prob) %>%
  rename(auc = .estimate) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "Down") %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(model, timepoint, auc, comparison)

#Plot curves ------------------
#PLOT ROC Curve
roc_curve_plot = roc_curve_up_notup %>% 
  bind_rows(roc_curve_down_notdown) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_num = readr::parse_number(timepoint),
    timepoint = paste0(timepoint, "h"),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = unique(timepoint[order(timepoint_num)]))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = 1 - specificity, 
             y = sensitivity, 
             color = model)) +
  geom_path(size = 1, alpha = 1) +
  geom_abline(lty = 3) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  facet_grid(~fct_rev(comparison)~timepoint) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  labs(
  x = "FPR",
  y = "TPR",
  color = "Model") + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.break = 3)

roc_curve_plot


# Visualize AUC
auc_plot <- bind_rows(auc_results_up, 
                      auc_results_down) %>% 
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = c("Perfect", "Mouse", "Immune", "Permutation")),
         comparison = factor(comparison, levels = c("Up", "Down"))) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = auc, 
             y = fct_reorder(timepoint, as.numeric(timepoint)) %>% fct_rev(), 
             fill = model)) +
  geom_col(width = 1,
           position = position_dodge(1)) +
  
  # Add a reference line for random prediction (AUC = 0.5)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_text(aes(label = round(auc, 2)),
            position = position_dodge2(1),
            color = "white", face = "bold",
            hjust = 1.2, size = 2.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  
  facet_grid(comparison ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
  
  labs(
    x = "AUC",
    y = "Day",
    fill = "Model"
  ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF",
    "Immune" = "#4361ee",
    "Human" = "#90A4AEFF",
    "Permutation" = "gray80"
    )) +
  theme_vaxgo()  +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    # strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    legend.key = element_blank()
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0), limits = c(0,1))

roc_auc_curve_plot = ((roc_curve_plot) |
  (auc_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"))) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 0.3))+
  plot_annotation(theme = theme(legend.position = "top", plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)),
                  title = paste(filename, gene_set_filename))

roc_auc_curve_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", paste0(filename, "_performance_roc_", gene_set_filename, ".png")),
         width = 10,
         height = 5)
```

Calculate ROC curve


```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
#=====================================================
# Compute probabilities
#=====================================================

dge_long_genes_up = hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t > 0, "up", "not_up"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

dge_long_genes_down = hallmarks_df_input %>% 
  mutate(
    df = n_genes - 1,
    t = mean_log2fc/(sd_log2fc/sqrt(n_genes)), 
    pval_one_sided = pt(t, df, lower.tail = TRUE),
    pval_one_sided_adj = p.adjust(pval_one_sided, method = "BH"),
    direction = if_else(pval_one_sided_adj <= 0.05 & t < 0, "down", "not_down"),
    prob = 1 - pval_one_sided_adj
  ) %>%
  rename(adj_p_val = pval_one_sided_adj)

#=====================================================
# Assign human truth
#=====================================================
truth_human_up = dge_long_genes_up %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

truth_human_down = dge_long_genes_down %>% 
  select(symbol, organism, timepoint, adj_p_val, direction) %>% 
  filter(organism == "Human") %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = organism, values_from = direction) %>% 
  rename(truth = Human) %>% 
  mutate(organism = "Human")

#=====================================================
#Generate reference distributions

  rename(pred = truth)

perfect_prediction_down = truth_human_down %>%

#=====================================================

  bind_rows(perfect_prediction_down, permutation_prediction_down)
```

```{r}
#Fluad vaccination
#Use Fluad uniform and human perfect distributions as reference to make the visualization easier
roc_curve_data_Fluad_Immune = readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_Fluad_Immune.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Permutation", "Human")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(model == "Permutation" ~ "Permutation",
                               model == "Human" ~ "Human",
                               T ~ condition)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 1)

roc_curve_data_Fluad_AllGenes = readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_Fluad_AllGenes.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model %in% c("Mouse", "Permutation", "Human")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = case_when(model == "Permutation" ~ "Permutation",
                               model == "Human" ~ "Human",
                               T ~ condition)) %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 1)

#Engerix B vaccination
roc_curve_data_EngerixB_AllGenes = readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_EngerixB_AllGenes.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model == "Mouse") %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 7)
roc_curve_data_EngerixB_Immune = readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_EngerixB_Immune.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model == "Mouse") %>% 
  filter(timepoint == 7)

#E. coli infection
roc_curve_data_EcoliInfection_Mouse24h_HumanHospitalization_Immune <- readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_EcoliInfection_Mouse24h_HumanHospitalization_Immune.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model == "Mouse")
roc_curve_data_EcoliInfection_Mouse24h_HumanHospitalization_AllGenes <- readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_EcoliInfection_Mouse24h_HumanHospitalization_AllGenes.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model == "Mouse")

#S. aureus
roc_curve_data_Saureus_Infection_AllGenes <- readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_Saureus_Infection_AllGenes.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model == "Mouse")
roc_curve_data_Saureus_Infection_Immune <- readRDS(here("tables", "roc_curve_data_Saureus_Infection_Immune.rds")) %>% 
  filter(model == "Mouse")


#Combine roc curves
roc_curves_combined = bind_rows(roc_curve_data_Fluad_Immune,
                                roc_curve_data_Fluad_AllGenes,
                                roc_curve_data_EngerixB_AllGenes,
                                roc_curve_data_EngerixB_Immune,
                                roc_curve_data_EcoliInfection_Mouse24h_HumanHospitalization_Immune,
                                roc_curve_data_EcoliInfection_Mouse24h_HumanHospitalization_AllGenes,
                                roc_curve_data_Saureus_Infection_AllGenes,
                                roc_curve_data_Saureus_Infection_Immune) %>% 
  mutate(geneset = if_else(str_detect(filename, "Immune"), "Immune", "All"),
         group = if_else(str_detect(condition, "Vaccination"), "Vaccination", "Infection"),
         condition = str_remove(condition, " infection|vaccination|_Vaccination"),
         condition = fct_relevel(condition, "Human", "Permutation", "Fluad", "E. coli", "S. aureus")) 

roc_curves_combined 
roc_curves_combined %>% 
  dplyr::count(condition)
```
